medicine.headline: Malaria vaccine reaches 20 million children
medicine.figureCap: fewer deaths from any cause among vaccinated under-fives
medicine.body: Twenty-three African countries have folded the vaccine into routine immunisation. Malaria has killed half a million children a year for as long as anyone has been counting. That number is moving.
medicine.ask: Now one small thing, while you're here. Whichever is nearest — they all count the same.
